apple.name: ZOVRO
apple.subtitle: Local Help, Right Nearby
apple.promotionalText: Find nearby providers for roadside, auto, home, moving, and urgent service requests. Request now or schedule for later.
apple.description:
ZOVRO helps customers connect with nearby service providers for everyday and urgent local-service needs.

Create a request, describe what you need, find suitable nearby providers, communicate in the app, follow job progress, and leave a rating when the work is complete. Providers can set their availability, receive relevant nearby requests, accept work, share updates, and build a service history.

Service categories include roadside assistance, mobile auto service, plumbing, electrical, HVAC, appliance repair, roofing, painting, flooring, lawn care, snow removal, cleanup, moving, and other local services.

Location is requested only when you use a location-dependent feature. Verification badges are shown only when the corresponding verification has been completed.

ZOVRO urgent and SOS requests are marketplace service requests. ZOVRO does not provide police, fire, medical, or emergency-dispatch services and does not replace 911.
apple.reviewNotes: Use test accounts supplied privately in App Store Connect: one customer and one provider. Review request creation, provider acceptance, messaging, status updates, account deletion, password recovery, and SOS marketplace-assistance flows. ZOVRO SOS does not replace 911. Production secrets and review credentials are not stored in this repository. Push delivery should be evaluated only after the submitted signed build has a registered OneSignal device subscription.
